title: A Bakery for the Promise
author: Casper Pemberton
blurb: Wren Kavanagh, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
